bio.text: Nadia Milleron is an independent candidate for Massachusetts's 1st Congressional District in 2026, facing Rep. Richard Neal; she also ran against him in 2024.
As of 2024 she had lived in the district for 25 years, working as a farmer in Sheffield, and she has advocated for increased oversight of the airline industry since 2020.
She holds a bachelor's degree in government from Smith College and a law degree from the University of Iowa.
